changelogversion.changelogtext: [b]Komiho 1.7.0[/b]
[b]New[/b] Local file browser now supports long-press file management
[b]New[/b] File browser (local / SMB / WebDAV) now shows reading progress
[b]New[/b] File browser (local / SMB / WebDAV) adds a compact grid display mode
[b]New[/b] Image enhancement — NPU power mode: Performance is faster but runs hotter, Balanced runs cooler at moderate speed — pick whichever suits you
[b]New[/b] Settings → Komga: choose whether to show the file name or the title
[b]New[/b] Settings → Storage: cache size limit
[b]Improved[/b] The PDF reading module was rewritten, fixing slow opening, stuttery reading and blurry output
[b]Fixed[/b] Opening EPUB files could crash back to the file browser on certain Android versions
[b]Komiho 1.6.0[/b]
[b]New[/b] Paged-mode page animation: choose between Slide / Cover / Page-curl
[b]New[/b] Paged-mode double-tap zoom toggle; turning it off removes the double-tap delay so taps respond immediately, zoom with a two-finger pinch instead
[b]New[/b] (experimental) Image enhancement — MediaTek NPU upscaling (MTK model package)
[b]Improved[/b] E-Ink skin is now a solid-color design
[b]Improved[/b] Double-page split logic
[b]Fixed[/b] Komga reading progress occasionally resetting when a book was opened from the chapter list
[b]Fixed[/b] AVIF covers not showing on some OEM ROMs missing the underlying codec
[b]Fixed[/b] Image enhancement being dropped when turning pages quickly in paged mode
[b]Fixed[/b] SMB browsing starting directory being duplicated when opened from history

[b]MediaTek NPU upscaling — notes[/b] The developer has no MediaTek device; this feature is experimental. The model is compiled on first use; after that it is reused and there is no further wait. The official support list is too vague: in theory any SoC from MT6878 onward works, but whether compilation actually succeeds depends on the NeuroPilot and NPU driver shipped in the vendor firmware
[b]Komiho 1.5.0[/b]
[b]New[/b] E-Ink mode (Settings → Appearance): the reader switches to a dedicated E-Ink grayscale mode. Tested on a limited set of devices — feedback and suggestions are welcome
[b]New[/b] MOBI/AZW3/AZW support
[b]New[/b] Reading background "Parchment / Kraft"
[b]New[/b] Deep crop: crops by the connected-component content bounding box, cutting through black frames, watermarks and page numbers
[b]New[/b] Settings → About → Feedback & suggestions (GitHub issue / Tencent Survey)
[b]Improved[/b] WebDAV covers now also work for folders (WebDAV → show covers)
[b]Improved[/b] Super-resolution scheduling: a page preempted by rapid taps in paged mode is re-run after the paging pause
[b]Fixed[/b] Double-page pairing got out of sync after rotating the screen
[b]Fixed[/b] Bottom navigation icons were squeezed by the system navigation bar
[b]Fixed[/b] Missing simplified/traditional Chinese translations in the reader menu and some settings
[b]Komiho 1.4.1[/b]
[b]Fixed[/b] Reading history could not record the page number
[b]New[/b] WebDAV sync
[b]New[/b] Image enhancement — moiré reduction
[b]New[/b] Settings → Advanced → progress bar thumbnails
[b]New[/b] Settings → Advanced → export diagnostic log
[b]New[/b] Settings → Advanced → show WebDAV covers
[b]New[/b] NPU models Real-CUGAN Pro/SE (requires updating the model package)
[b]Improved[/b] AI enhancement scheduling, Vulkan inference, and progress bar dragging performance
[b]Improved[/b] Auto webtoon mode detection
[b]Fixed[/b] PDF cover / page count display
[b]Fixed[/b] DRM-protected EPUBs now clearly report that they can't be read
[b]Fixed[/b] Permission-only encrypted PDFs no longer ask for a password
[b]Fixed[/b] Certificate-based DRM PDFs now show a clear message instead of looping on "wrong password"
[b]Komiho 1.3.1[/b]
[b]New[/b] Image enhancement — "Force AI on large images" toggle: images with enough resolution but poor scan quality also get AI detail restoration
[b]New[/b] Remote cache progress animation
[b]Improved[/b] Enhancement badge now shows the output resolution
[b]Improved[/b] "Opening" hint shown while decoding to avoid a black screen with no feedback
[b]Fixed[/b] WebToon mode could intermittently get stuck on the loading spinner
[b]Fixed[/b] Image-type EPUB falls back to the file browser after opening
[b]Fixed[/b] Settings → Storage "remote cache" stats missed the PDF cache
[b]Komiho 1.3.0[/b]
[b]New[/b] Local / WebDAV / SMB PDF reading
[b]New[/b] File browser search
[b]New[/b] Image enhancement — denoise
[b]Improved[/b] File browser now sorts by number / letter / pinyin initial
[b]Fixed[/b] Nubia / Red Magic failing to load NPU models
[b]Komiho 1.2.0[/b]
[b]New[/b] AI image upscaling (GPU / NPU): base code ported from mihon_img_upscale
[b]New[/b] Source management gains a "Startup" section to pick the default cold-start behavior
[b]New[/b] Same-path folder auto-load; loose-image folder continues to the next volume after finishing one
[b]Improved[/b] Reader performance improved, several bugs fixed
[b]Improved[/b] Reader paged and WebToon mode cache values are now adjustable
[b]Improved[/b] Image enhancement applies in real time
[b]Improved[/b] Komga UI reworked — downloads now work
[b]Improved[/b] Enhancement badge shows engine and timing accurately per page
[b]Fixed[/b] Full i18n (zh / zh-TW / en); all screens display correctly after switching language
[b]Fixed[/b] Cold start always landed on the welcome page
[b]Fixed[/b] SMB / CIFS browsing could intermittently fail when the OS reclaimed the idle connection
[b]Fixed[/b] Komga recents cover used the series cover instead of the book cover
[b]New[/b] Local file browsing
[b]New[/b] WebDAV share browsing
[b]New[/b] SMB/CIFS share browsing
[b]New[/b] Local bookmarks and history
[b]New[/b] Source management — one place to manage every source
[b]New[/b] Recents, now the default start page
[b]Improved[/b] Komga UI redone — much nicer to use now
[b]Improved[/b] Manga reader performance improvements
[b]New[/b] Multiple Komga servers: add several, switch the active one from Settings, edit or delete each entry
[b]New[/b] Settings → About page: version, check for updates (repo ruzhe85/Komiho), GitHub source link
[b]Improved[/b] Search and filter: filter by tag or author; search spans all libraries on Home and the current library inside one; results reuse the library display mode
[b]Fixed[/b] Tapping "Reconfigure connection" no longer jumps back to Home; "Clear connection" clears only connection data and no longer wipes display / theme / language preferences

[b]Fixed[/b] Reader and detail pages no longer wrongly show "Open in WebView / Open in browser / Share" (Komga uses an internal scheme and is now excluded); the same option is hidden in Settings → bottom buttons
[b]Note[/b] Legacy single-connection configs are migrated automatically on first launch — nothing is lost
